company_overview: Postman is the world’s leading API platform, simplifying the entire API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration for developers. It enables the development, testing, management, and distribution of APIs and services, catering to both engineers and enterprise-scale needs.
target_audience: Developers, API architects, and IT professionals involved in designing, building, and managing APIs, particularly those focused on modern application development and integration.

company_overview: Supabase is a Postgres-based open-source Firebase alternative that provides a fully managed backend for developers, offering features like authentication, real-time data, and storage. It empowers teams to build and scale applications quickly with a focus on developer experience and enterprise-grade security.
target_audience: Developers and teams building web and mobile applications, particularly those seeking a flexible, scalable, and easy-to-use backend solution with a strong open-source community.

company_overview: Vapi is a developer platform that enables businesses to build advanced voice AI agents. It handles the complex infrastructure, allowing companies to focus on creating engaging voice experiences for their customers.
target_audience: Vapi’s target audience includes businesses of all sizes, particularly those seeking to improve customer support, automate workflows, and engage with customers through voice interactions. It caters to enterprises and organizations needing scalable, reliable voice AI solutions.
